visual_action: A fast-paced montage of images, including a screenshot of a data chart from Statista titled "Unvaccinated Drive Worst Single Measles Outbreak Since 2000" which presents data for "Measles cases in the United States in 2025". The video also includes still photos of Robert F. Kennedy Jr., cartoon drawings of a worm, and a photo of RFK Jr. with two black birds superimposed near his shoulder. A text overlay is present throughout.

cast.name: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
cast.evidence: His face appears multiple times in still photos and he is named in the on-screen text: "Brainworm linked up with RFK Jr..."

on_screen_text.text: Brainworm linked up with RFK Jr to implement the most cursed anti-science health policy in history
Unvaccinated Drive Worst Single Measles Outbreak Since 2000
Measles cases in the United States in 2025, by age and vaccination status

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video, only instrumental music.
audio_music: A distorted, high-pitched, and glitchy electronic track plays continuously throughout the video. The sound has a chaotic and mocking effect.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a rapid montage with very fast cuts between different images.
manipulation_or_satire: In one shot, two black birds are digitally superimposed into a photo of Robert F. Kennedy Jr., appearing to sit on a railing next to him.
central_claim: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s anti-science views will directly cause a catastrophic and deadly measles outbreak in the near future.
intended_effect: To portray Robert F. Kennedy Jr. as a dangerous and ridiculous figure whose policies will have severe public health consequences, thereby generating fear and ridicule towards him.
uncertainty_flags: The authenticity of the Statista chart depicting a 2025 measles outbreak cannot be verified from the video alone; it may be a real projection or a fabricated graphic for the post.
